repo_notes.content: This is a twenty-crate Rust Cargo workspace producing one MCP service binary. ck-core holds domain entities/ports; ck-app orchestrates use cases; ck-bin composes runtime; ck-mcp dispatches tools; concrete source/storage/retrieval/transport adapters supply implementation. Trace actual wired code and tests, not just narrative documents.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: Canonical project memory exists under .agents/ (project_state.md, current_plan.md, work_log.md, decisions.md, open_questions.md, evidence.md, OBSERVED_DEBT.md). Previous root instructions mistakenly referred to .agent/. This onboarding changes their path references; never create a duplicate memory hierarchy.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: Treat AGENTS.md as working rules. Context_Kernel_Service_Specification.md and Context_Kernel_Service_Plan.md record intended design, not evidence of current implementation. Distinguish implemented, partially implemented, stubbed, not implemented and unclear. Verify behavior against source and runnable tests before claims.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: The concrete retrieval path is source discovery/fetch -> normalization/chunking -> SQLite documents, chunks and FTS5 -> optional scoped vector retrieval -> intent-aware ranking -> compact cited responses. Distinguish library identity resolution, retrieval, context continuity and artifact storage; context access alone does not prove reliable capability.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: Security distinctions matter: stdio local trust is not SSE bearer authentication; enforce tool/corpus authorizations, private-scope checks and safe external fetch behavior. Cover web SSRF and DNS defenses, GitHub truncated trees and artifact path validation using relevant tests.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: The Rust context_required tool is composed in ck-bin conditionally via CK_CONTEXT_CORPUS_ROOT and/or CK_LEARNING_PROPOSALS_LEDGER; compare ck-mcp handler and executable tests. Python integration/agentic_capability_loop/adapters.py is a test-oriented helper and may generate synthetic citations; do not represent its output as production retrieved evidence.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: Preserve the shipping executable spelling context-kernal in accurate CLI examples; rename only with an explicit compatibility decision. Rust 1.92.0 pinned in rust-toolchain.toml, no Bun/Node application, and external embeddings are optional. Describe missing OTEL exporter, PDF ingestion and Context7 dataset adapter as unimplemented if source inspection confirms.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers

repo_notes.content: Prioritize code/test references over historical .agents logs or long skills reference bundles. Keep documentation within the minimum useful hierarchy, and do not claim a successful Devin snapshot/wiki generation until actually observed.
repo_notes.author: Context Kernel maintainers
